title: MicroStrategy Intelligence Server Errors
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSSErrors/statistics, Cognos audit database via DB Connect, BusinessObjects Auditing/CMS logs, Oracle Analytics usage tracking, ThoughtSpot audit logs, QuickSight CloudTrail and SPICE CloudWatch metrics.
app: MicroStrategy / IBM Cognos / SAP BusinessObjects / Oracle Analytics / ThoughtSpot / Amazon QuickSight logs via Universal Forwarder, vendor admin APIs, and cloud provider TAs (`Splunk_TA_aws` for QuickSight).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=microstrategy:dsserror
| stats count as errors by error_code, project_name
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Surfaces MicroStrategy Intelligence Server errors by project so report and cube failures are diagnosed before they spread.
value: Intelligence Server errors break reports and cubes for whole projects; error-code visibility speeds root-cause and recovery.
implementation: Ingest DSSErrors logs; schedule every 15 minutes; alert on error spikes per project.
visualization: Table by error code/project, timechart of errors.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the engine behind MicroStrategy reports and flag errors before they break reports for a whole team.
